what_is_index.title: Why?
what_is_index.heading: What is index.life?
what_is_index.body: Index.life is a local diary application created by Emile Alexanyan so that he could better remember and understand himself. But more importantly, index.life is an idea — the idea that it's useful to have a place where you write down what you think and feel about your day. Throughout my life, I often caught myself realizing that I couldn't even remember what had happened earlier that same week. One day replaces another endlessly, and everything starts to feel the same. Index.life is a way to look back at your notes and reflections about past days, to draw conclusions and think about them. The calendar design is inspired by a heatmap. I noticed that such a grid motivates me not to skip days and to fill in every single one.

assistant.proactive_streak: By the way, you've journaled {days} days in a row — that's a great habit!
assistant.proactive_trend_up: I've noticed your mood has been gradually rising lately — that's wonderful.
assistant.proactive_trend_down: It looks like the past few days have been harder than usual. I'm here if you'd like to talk.

chart_desc.river: Smoothed line crossing the year, raw daily dots, soft area fill underneath, and a vertical "today" marker.
chart_desc.spiral: Each day a dot on an unwinding spiral. Concentric guide rings, month markers, and a today highlight.
chart_desc.rhythm: Heatmap with weekday rows and month columns. Cell darkness encodes the average rating for that combination.
chart_desc.rose: Seven petals, one per weekday — shape shows that weekday's rating distribution; darkness shows its average.
chart_desc.ridgeline: Twelve stacked ridges, one per month — shape reveals each month's rating distribution.
chart_desc.overview: Year heatmap of daily ratings; the landing-page summary view.
chart_desc.activities-zoom: Packed circles — bigger = more mentions; outer shade = mood vs your average; inner shade = that day's rating.
customization.bg_desc: Solid color, gradient, or your own image.
customization.fonts_desc: Font for body text and headings. All options are bundled locally — the app works offline. You can upload your own file (.ttf/.otf/.woff/.woff2, up to 5 MB).
customization.notes_font_desc_off: When off — notes always render in Times New Roman (historic look). When on — the chosen body font also applies to textarea / WYSIWYG / preview on the entry-editing page.
customization.colors_desc: Text color and accent color (active link).
customization.mosaic_desc: An image is 'spread' across the calendar (12 months = one canvas). Each cube is a window into its piece. A filled day shows the 'filled' layer; an empty day shows the 'empty' layer (can be a color, gradient, or a second image that 'reveals' itself as days fill in).
customization.mosaic_empty_desc: Each empty day shows its piece of this image. When the day is filled — the 'empty' piece disappears and the 'filled' piece appears in its place. Effect: one image gradually replaces another as the calendar fills in.
customization.cubes_desc: Cube colors on the main calendar page.
customization.charts_global_desc: Global defaults for all insights charts. Used when a specific chart has no override of its own in the subsections below.
customization.charts_per_chart: Each chart is customized separately below — live preview inside its own subsection.
customization.neural_desc: Neuron color and edge color on the topic map.
customization.cleanup_desc: Uploaded images and fonts live in the app's user-data folder. If you experimented with different background variants — old files stay on disk even after you removed them from settings. This button lists 'orphan' files (no longer referenced) and removes them on confirmation.
customization.export_title: Download the current theme as a JSON file
customization.import_title: Load a previously saved theme from a JSON file
customization.auto_invert_desc: Recomputes body text and muted text against the effective background. Use when a dark overlay or photo would leave black text unreadable — your manual text color is ignored while this is on.
customization.preview_muted_sample: Muted secondary text — captions, hints, timestamps

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.subtitle: Your mood, drawn from different angles
graphics.analysis_running: Analysis runs in the background — come back in a few minutes
graphics.card.overview.title: Overview
graphics.card.overview.desc: The whole year as a single heatmap calendar. Each cell is a day shaded by your mood rating; alongside, monthly averages and the overall distribution.
graphics.card.spiral.title: Spiral year
graphics.card.spiral.desc: The year wound onto a spiral — every day is a dot moving outward from January to December. Shade encodes the mood, so streaks and seasons stand out at a glance.
graphics.card.rose.title: Rose
graphics.card.rose.desc: Seven petals, one per weekday. The longer the petal, the higher your average mood on that day; the darker, the more entries you have. Quickly answers "which day of the week is best for me?"
graphics.card.ridgeline.title: Ridgeline
graphics.card.ridgeline.desc: Twelve stacked silhouettes, one per month. Each shape is that month's distribution of ratings — peaks show your typical mood, tails reveal the unusual days.
graphics.card.rhythm.title: Rhythm
graphics.card.rhythm.desc: A weekday × month grid. Each cell is the average mood for that combination — Mondays in March vs. Saturdays in July. Reveals weekly rhythms across the seasons.
graphics.card.words.title: Words
graphics.card.words.desc: Words from your notes ranked by the mood of the days they appear on. "Lifts" are the words tied to your best days; "drags" to the worst.
graphics.card.activities.title: Activities
graphics.card.activities.desc: Activities the AI psychologist extracted from your notes, packed as bubbles. Bubble size = how often the activity appears; shade = mood vs your average on those days. Click an activity to drill into individual mentions, hover for the actual diary text, click a mention to open that day.
graphics.card.activities_zoom.title: Activities
graphics.card.activities_zoom.desc: Activities the AI psychologist extracted from your notes, packed as bubbles. Bubble size = how often the activity appears; shade = mood vs your average on those days. Click an activity to drill into individual mentions, hover for the actual diary text, click a mention to open that day.
graphics.card.people.title: People
graphics.card.people.desc: Names and roles the AI psychologist extracts from your notes, scored by the tone of how you mention them — who lifts you up, who drags you down.
graphics.card.river.title: River of mood
graphics.card.river.desc: Your mood as a flowing line across the year. The smooth curve is a 14-day rolling average; raw daily dots sit beneath it; the vertical marker is today.
